featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a very beautiful building. I liked this building very much.
Beautiful entry lobby and very nice podium, clean environment including beautiful children's play area,
A community space for small parties,
A well-equipped exercise area.
It is a beautiful park-like place where people stroll in the morning and evening.
The apartment complex is equipped with 2 regular and 2 service, good quality Schindler lifts.
There is a beautifully designed parking inside the building for car parking.
Some people say that this area may not be luxurious, but my point is that this place is conveniently located from Kandivali station and easily accessible from the link road. Coming and going can be done. There is an auto rickshaw stand in front of the building, where you can get autos to travel all over Mumbai at very low cost. The auto driver says that we can travel the whole of Mumbai by taking the auto.
The link road is expected to be connected to the highway with a flyover in the coming years. Access to Metro 2 may also be convenient in future. Easy connectivity to/from the railway station as there is a share rickshaw stand right next to it.
The streets around the building may be developed in a few years, I think perhaps all of them will be developed in five years.

If you like it, you can invest in this building.
But whatever you do, invest money only after meeting the owner of the building and seeing the surrounding environment. We have told only what we liked, but some of our words may prove to be wrong. Therefore, we should not be held responsible for them.
